[[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr]] '''N2-f microthrusters''' were maneuvering thrusters used on the [[StarViper-class attack platform/Legends|StarViper]] prototype, ''[[Virago]]''. A pair of N2-f units were mounted on each wingtip and coordinated by the flight computer to enhance the fighter's maneuverability.<ref name="EGVV" />
